title: Pure Enneacraft
summary: Pure Enneacraft Pendulum Flip control deck with generic handtraps and staples. Every Enneacraft is a Pendulum Flip monster: the Level 1s search from the Pendulum Zone and flip face-up on the opponent's turn to answer specific actions, while the Level 9s impose continuous floodgates and burn damage once flipped face-up.

summary.title: Starters
points: Enneacraft Release places any Enneacraft monster from the Deck directly into your Pendulum Zone, and from the GY returns a face-up Enneacraft from the Extra Deck to the hand.
Trito Enneacraft - "exapatisIA" and the other Level 1 Enneacrafts activate in the Pendulum Zone to reveal three Enneacraft cards from your Deck so your opponent picks one to add to your hand.
Enneacraft Reset places the Field Spell Enneapolis from the Deck, or negates face-up cards on the field up to the number of cards in your Pendulum Zones.

summary.title: Opening: Enneacraft Release + Trito Enneacraft - "exapatisIA"
steps: Activate Enneacraft Release to place a Level 1 Enneacraft in your Pendulum Zone, then activate its Scale effect to reveal 3 Enneacraft cards and add 1 to your hand.
Set Trito Enneacraft - "exapatisIA" and a reactive Level 1 or Level 9 Enneacraft in face-down Defense Position.
Activate Enneacraft Reset to place Enneapolis in the Field Zone.

On the opponent's turn, flip your face-down Enneacrafts in response to their plays—triggering exapatisIA to destroy a Spell/Trap and Set another Enneacraft from the hand or Deck—then use Enneapolis to bounce flipped monsters back to the hand or Pendulum Zone to reuse them.

summary.title: Reactive Level 1 Flip Traps
summary.text: Each Level 1 Enneacraft automatically flips itself face-up in response to a specific opponent action and resolves a disruption effect: Proto Enneacraft - "orgIA" flips on a handtrap activation to search and destroys a monster; Deftero Enneacraft - "alazoneIA" answers an opponent's search and banishes a random card from their hand; Ekto Enneacraft - "tromarIA" answers a Special Summon and negates a monster; and Enato Enneacraft - "oknirIA" answers a GY or banishment effect and shuffles the opponent's GY back into the Deck.

summary.title: Level 9 Floodgate Bosses
points: Enneacraft - Atil.SPIA (2026 Blazing Dominion support) prevents the opponent from chaining to their own card and effect activations once flipped face-up.
Enneacraft - Atori.MAR flips all opposing monsters face-down and locks their battle positions.

Enneacraft - Asta.PIXEA prevents the opponent from targeting cards on the field or in either GY, while Enneacraft - Archa.TAIL burns whenever opposing monsters go to the GY and Enneacraft - Aiza.LEON burns for every card the opponent adds by effect.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Enneapolis returns face-up Enneacrafts on your field to the hand or Pendulum Zone so they can be Set again, while dealing burn damage scaled to E.C. Counters.
Enneacraft Reset banishes itself from the GY to flip your face-up monsters back into face-down Defense Position for another round of Flip effects.
Enneacraft Reverth shuffles Enneacrafts back to draw cards, and from the GY Sets an Enneacraft face-down when the opponent summons a monster.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: The page's Zaborg the Mega Monarch Extra Deck rip package is omitted to keep the build pure Enneacraft control.
